ROOT-CAUSE PASS ON "BUILT, DECLARED, AND UNREACHED", run under the root-cause skill at Anthony's request 2026-08-31 after the shape turned up eight times in one session.

═══ ② THE CAUSE IS ALREADY RECORDED, WITH NUMBERS, AND STEP ② FOUND IT ═══
No new cause was derived. `fact:the-three-legs-audit-run-at-last-54-of-93-and-five-types-exist-only-in-the-schema` (2026-08-26) swept all 93 declared types against the three legs — typed tool, instruction, absence-detector:
    all three legs   54 (58%)     NO LEGS AT ALL   13 (14%)
    five types exist ONLY in the schema: COMPLIES_WITH, IMPOSES, OPERATES_IN, SUPPLEMENTS, VIOLATES_RULE

And `dec:idea-have-the-three-legs-been-applied-uniformly-and-are-three-legs-enough` (OPEN) already records that THREE LEGS ARE NOT SUFFICIENT, measured twice: `DECOMPOSES` had all three and stayed at ZERO edges, because its detector "fires on a Requirement that ALREADY CARRIES an incoming DECOMPOSES edge — it checks whether an existing decomposition is covered; it cannot ask why none exists". Half-idea linking had all three and left 110 ideas unlinked. Its conclusion is the hypothesis: "Is there a FOURTH leg: something that makes the practice HAPPEN, rather than merely possible and observable?"

⇒ SO THIS SESSION ADDS EVIDENCE, NOT A DIAGNOSIS. Five of that audit's types had all three legs and zero instances; today found eight more of the same family in one day.

═══ ③ THE EIGHT, MEASURED ═══
    the `optimize` skill                run 2 times ever
    Constraint / budget_report          4 constraints, 0 of category kpp
    set_capability_signature            3 of 192 capabilities
    Interface as a VERIFIES target      3 of 22 interfaces — but 3 of 3 PUBLISHED ones, so arguably working
    the GraphRead trait                 3 of 45 struct-coupled modules
    Decision.kind                       12 of 584, read only by a report
    Requirement.lineage                 205/205 at the DEFAULT, read by nothing
    the worktree fork path              documented, and a real project parked for want of finding it

═══ ⭐⭐ ④ ONE OF THE EIGHT IS A DIFFERENT SHAPE, AND IT IS THE EXPENSIVE ONE ═══
The worktree fork has ALL THE LEGS. The mechanism exists (store is single-writer per DIRECTORY, `--import` seeds a fresh one in one command), the instruction exists and is correct and complete, and it is a SERVED skill. Nothing is missing.

🛑 IT IS FILED UNDER A DESCRIPTION NOBODY LOOKING FOR IT WOULD SEARCH. `parallel-work` opens "Use when two or more people (or agents) need to work on one design at the same time without colliding". A user wanting to EXPLORE AN ALTERNATIVE does not match on that, and ophyd-service's agent ran `find_tools` before filing, concluded `tool_missing`, and parked a real architecture question with an idle code branch.

⇒ THAT IS NOT A MISSING LEG. IT IS A MISROUTED ONE — leg 2 present, correct, and addressed to the wrong reader. The three-leg frame cannot see it, because the frame asks WHETHER an instruction exists and never WHOM IT IS ADDRESSED TO.

⭐ AND THE PARTIAL PRECEDENT EXISTS: `cap:every-served-report-is-reachable-from-an-instruction` makes CI fail when a served *_report is named in no skill. The same idea, one layer over, for reports only — and it checks reachability, not whether the route matches the reader's words.

═══ ⑤ THE DISCRIMINATOR AMONG THE EIGHT, WHICH THE FOURTH-LEG HYPOTHESIS PREDICTS ═══
What the USED vocabulary has that these do not is not a leg — it is FORCE. `search_first` fires on every capture; the `revision` block on every revise; `loop_status` is pushed by a Stop hook; the export-lineage rule FAILS CI. Every one of those happens whether or not anybody reaches for it. All eight above require somebody to reach.

And it is independently measured: `fact:agents-do-self-invoke-skills-at-scale-and-the-hook-not-the-catalogue-predicts-which` — 93 sessions across two other projects, 88% of skill loads with no slash command behind them, and "what predicts a skill's load count is being named in the ALWAYS-INJECTED SessionStart hook, not being in the served catalogue."

═══ ⚠️ ⑥ WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH ═══
· NOTHING WAS BUILT AND NO CAUSE WAS NEWLY FOUND. The fourth-leg question stays open exactly where it was; this supplies instances and one sub-shape.
· LOW REACH IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY A DEFECT. 0 KPPs may be correct — reflow2 may have no threshold whose miss fails the effort — and Interface-as-VERIFIES is 3 of 3 on the interfaces that matter. Counting them together overstates the pattern, and they are listed separately for that reason.
· THE EIGHT ARE NOT INDEPENDENT SAMPLES. They are what one session happened to touch in one day, and finding the first primed the search for the rest — the same confound recorded on the stale-records count today.
· WHETHER FORCE IS THE FOURTH LEG IS AN INFERENCE FROM WHICH THINGS ARE USED HERE. Nobody has tried adding force to one unused capability and measured whether reach follows.
